items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Marrero; the interviewer identifies Marrero as Lawrence's father, and the interviewee responds by talking about a different person, Arthur Ogans.

ctx.x: Yeah I think he was his father. They called him Moran a lot of times, but I think his real name was Marrero, the same as Lawrence I thought. If he's the man that you mean.

This fellow here, they buried about almost a year ago, Arthur Ogans, he used to play drum. Oh yes. He was a drummer at the time. And I was on banjo, I think, on trombone. Did he have the trombone? Yeah I was trying to think really well. I can't go.
